// Issue #139: Stillness in Motion mills three at the beginning of each upkeep
// after the turn it is cast, before the draw.
//
// Twenty cards on the play. Four nonlands cannot keep two lands out of the
// first eight cards, or three out of the first nine, so Stillness' {1}{U} is
// paid on turn 2 whenever it is among the first eight, and on turn 3 when it
// is the ninth.
16x Island [Land]
1x Stillness in Motion [Mill]
3x Cid, Timeless Artificer [Cid]
